review_scope: Independent read-only challenge of the frozen kernel-arithmetic scout and retained-rowflag mapping feasibility. No candidate, exporter or package implementation is reviewed or authorized by this report.
arithmetic_conclusion: Bitwise whole-logical-opponent-row +0 is a sufficient conservative predicate. The original scan, card/same-combo corrections and lower/higher/tied masses then produce +0. Sum==0, floating equality==0, or sorted-subset-only flags are insufficient replacements.

All three actual cast f32 node payoffs must be finite. Present hands must retain the original win*lower + lose*higher + tie*tied expression at +0 masses, including signed-zero behavior; absent own hands retain explicit +0. These three payout arrays are common to both traversers.

A barrier between full logical-row zeroing and sorted present-hand overwrites is required: those stores can belong to different lanes. Keep the original first publication collective, card-position preload, fallback arithmetic, ABI, shared reservation and launch shape. The proposed fast branch retains two of five barriers, not a larger barrier advantage than closed E035.

Source algebra is not compiled numerical proof. Any later candidate still needs separately authorized actual-old-GPU comparisons for exact output bits, empty/full/partial lists, signed-zero and nonfinite fallback cases.
mapping_conclusion: Accepted Spot/GpuPlan construction has stable node, representative-worklist, river-slot and physical-reach-slot assignments: enumeration/first encounter sets order, not HashMap iteration. Exact frozen configurations and accepted source are required.

D066 verified complete uploaded reach-slot arrays and retained flags for every physical logical row. It did not download/verify show_nodes, node_river_slot or node_ttie. Derived showdown metadata must remain host-planned, supported by the exact constructor/upload source, not described as a new or historical device readback.

At the six recorded pre-evaluation training boundaries, E015 preserves reach1 from p0 while p1 refreshes reach0; up sweeps do not rewrite reaches. Thus traverser p joins opponent q=1-p. This does not establish incidence at every iteration or during evaluation.

The smallest justified next preparation is one CPU-only accepted Spot/GpuPlan derivation, one fixture at a time. Require all three complete saved fold maps byte-exact plus recorded dimensions/spans before the assessor joins any of the twelve retained flag files. Check planned-show coverage, unique terminal IDs, river/count/row bounds and all three f32 payoff bits; count each planned CTA once per traverser without owner deduplication.
strongest_counterargument: Every CTA would pay predicate/control/register costs; original staging and output stores remain. Two historical snapshots per fixture and whole-row incidence do not measure skipped cost, all-iteration frequency or complete-cycle headroom. E035 remains rejected and closed; no speed or >=2% inference follows from this distinct source opportunity.
recommendation: GO only for the separately authorized minimal off-tree CPU mapping-helper preparation in mapping-preparation.json. Its source/schema/scripts must be reviewed and root must separately authorize compilation/execution. No production fast path or new GPU census is justified by this review alone.
preserved_limits: Published D066 evidence and fold counts are unchanged. Flags are source-pinned native classifications; raw reach values were not retained.
Future planned-show counts cannot prove shortcut output correctness, actual GPU work duration or savings.
Original reports and additive source-location clarification were preserved; no review failures or source mutations occurred.
